gloss: food from the mountains; the bounty of the mountains

definitions.gloss: food from the mountains; the bounty of the mountains
definitions.explanation: Mushrooms, wild plants, nuts, game and other food gathered in the mountains, spoken of as a gift of nature.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{幸|さち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the bounty of the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{山|やま}の{幸|さち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Autumn is the season when mountain foods taste best.

examples.japanese: きのこや⟦{山菜|さんさい}→山菜：12404_sansai⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、{山|やま}の{幸|さち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふんだん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: We ate a hot pot generously made with mountain foods such as mushrooms and wild vegetables.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{幸|さち}{山|やま}の{幸|さち}: the bounty of sea and mountains
- ⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{山|やま}の{幸|さち}: autumn's mountain foods (mushrooms, chestnuts)
- {山|やま}の{幸|さち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: dishes made with mountain foods

CULTURAL NOTE:
The pair goes back to the myth of {海幸彦|うみさちひこ} and {山幸彦|やまさちひこ}, two brothers who lived by fishing and hunting. Today the phrase is common on inn and restaurant menus, especially in autumn.
